template/html#

HTML templates that escape each value for where it lands.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let card = HtmlTemplate("<p title=\"{{.}}\">Hello, {{.}}</p>");
card.string(Json("Ada & \"friends\""));   // <p title="Ada &amp; &quot;friends&quot;">…

Description#

HTML templates that escape each value for where it lands.

Values may go into text and into a whitelist of quoted ordinary attributes; anywhere else, such as an event handler attribute, the template is refused with InvalidHtmlTemplate before anything is written. The template's own markup must be balanced; nothing is sanitized or repaired.

HtmlTemplate is template/engine's Template with TemplateEscaping.html and no partials (#178): the one engine compiles, checks and renders it, and its refusals come back as InvalidHtmlTemplate. Sections are checked as the engine checks them; a partial is refused, as there is no library.
